'''Victory Base''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]]. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], it was [[Halmad campaign|raided]] by [[Wraith Squadron]], in the guise of the [[Hawk-bat Independent Space Force]]. Of the eight [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] in the base, five were stolen and the rest were destroyed by the Wraiths.
